metadata.scenario: simple anechoic stereo loudspeakers at +/-30 degrees, elevation 0 degrees
metadata.rtf: identity anechoic RTF; BRIR equals measured KEMAR HRTF/HRIR padded to 1024 taps
metadata.source: MIT Media Lab KEMAR HRTF compact measurements
metadata.resampling: linear interpolation from 44100 Hz to 48000 Hz
metadata.azimuth_convention: H0e030a.wav is +30 degrees; -30 degrees is mirrored by swapping ears for this symmetric simple scenario
metadata.normalization: original PCM16 amplitude converted to float by dividing by 32768; no relative path gain normalization
